expectations.text: Advises against the reflexive smart/dumb/styles 3-way split
expectations.evidence: "don't do the three-file smart/dumb/styles split. At 180 lines and one coherent concern, that pattern would make this file worse"

expectations.text: Recommends extracting a hook (abstraction) instead of splitting container/view files
expectations.evidence: "reach for an abstraction, not a file split. ... Extract a useSavedCards() hook: const { cards, loading } = useSavedCards();"

expectations.text: Notes ~180 lines is acceptable as one cohesive file (raised size threshold)
expectations.evidence: "Keep it as one file. 180 lines of one cohesive component is comfortably under the threshold... (roughly a few hundred lines)."

expectations.text: Grounds advice in AI agents' reluctance to read adjacent files / cross-file context cost
expectations.evidence: "An agent... works with the file that's open and is reluctant to go read the siblings"; "doubled the cross-file lookups the agent skips."
